svg.text: Insert Coin: blank secure chip, breadboard test
Cardputer OFF and NFC Cap removed while wiring. Before fitting the chip: pin 6 ≈ 5 V, red rail ≈ 3.3 V (meter).
1. Check the regulator's pin order on its datasheet first (usually GND, IN, OUT with the flat side facing you).
2. R1 and R2 go to the +3.3 V rail, never to 5 V: 5 V on SDA/SCL can damage the Cardputer.
3. If your breadboard's rails are split in the middle, bridge each with a short jumper.
4. Then power on: SETUP › HARDWARE › SECURE CHIP should say blank chip (0x60). Detecting only reads; nothing gets locked.
